message: Hi, my kid Jude is 9 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?
Hey! Yes, we do have Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for kids. Jude is the perfect age to start. We offer a free trial class so he can see if he likes it. Would you like to get him signed up for that?
Yes, I'd love to sign him up for the free trial class! What times do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Now I just need Jude's full name and date of birth to get him set up for the trial.
His full name is Jude Marina, and he was born on July 30, 2016.

Awesome! Jude is all set. I have a couple times available this week for his free trial:

Tuesday, July 7th at 5:30 PM
Thursday, July 9th at 5:30 PM

Which works better for you?
Let's go with Tuesday, July 7th at 5:30 PM. Thank you!
Perfect! Jude is booked for Tuesday, July 7th at 5:30 PM. We'll have a loaner uniform ready for him, so no need to bring anything. Just come ready to have fun! See you then!
